title: Turkish Class
description: Voegelin, assisted by his three students, taught a new course in the Turkish language. It was created at the request of the American Council of Learned Societies to prepare students for vital jobs in the war effort where a knowledge of the Turkish language is needed.
creator: Francis Allan “F. Allan” Graham
